gaps.topic: device IBEX-Q1 on Amazon Braket not in atlas
gaps.why: The Braket devices page lists AQT IBEX-Q1 as a gate-based QPU. The atlas systems for AQT are MARMOT, LYNX, and the LRZ installation. The AQT products page lists IBEX Q1 separately from MARMOT.
gaps.would_need: A system record whose evidence names this device, or a primary document that identifies it with an existing sys: id.

gaps.topic: device ibm_boston on IBM Quantum Platform not in atlas
gaps.why: The compute-resources page lists ibm_boston online, processor family Heron, 156 programmable qubits. sys:ibm-heron is the processor class, not this named QPU.
gaps.would_need: A system record whose evidence names this device, or a primary document that identifies it with an existing sys: id.

gaps.topic: device IQM Crystal 54 on IQM Resonance not in atlas

gaps.topic: device IQM Crystal 20 on IQM Resonance not in atlas

gaps.topic: device IQM Star 24 on IQM Resonance not in atlas

gaps.topic: device willow_pink on Google Quantum AI not in atlas
gaps.why: The Quantum Computing Service concepts page gives willow_pink as an example processor id in Santa Barbara. sys:google-willow is the Willow processor reported in the 2024 experiment. The concepts page does not say willow_pink is that system.
gaps.would_need: A system record whose evidence names this device, or a primary document that identifies it with an existing sys: id.

gaps.topic: Xanadu Cloud
gaps.why: https://www.xanadu.ai/ returned a title shell and did not name a cloud QPU. The Strawberry Fields documentation index names Hardware and Cloud sections and does not name a QPU a user can submit to.
gaps.would_need: A current Xanadu page that names a cloud QPU, its status, and the line that selects it.

gaps.topic: Quandela Cloud
gaps.why: The Quandela Cloud page names a QPU reservation service and photonic computers, and the navigation names Ascella, Belenos, and Canopus. The fetched page does not give a per-device availability status.
gaps.would_need: A Quandela device list that states which QPU can be submitted to, with status and the selection step.

gaps.topic: Rigetti QCS
gaps.why: The PyQuil getting-started page fetched here shows get_qc('9q-square-qvm') and does not name Ankaa-3 or Cepheus-1-108Q. Rigetti QPUs are listed on Amazon Braket.
gaps.would_need: A Rigetti QCS device list that names the current QPUs and the get_qc argument for one of them.

gaps.topic: AQT ARNICA
gaps.why: The ARNICA product page describes remote access to IBEX quantum computers. The products page says ARNICA is remote access to IBEX quantum computers and does not state an access tier. IBEX Q1 is not an existing sys: id.
gaps.would_need: An ARNICA page that states the access tier and a code line that selects IBEX Q1.

gaps.topic: D-Wave Leap pricing and sampler line
gaps.why: The cloud page says customers can access the two named annealing systems. The Leap service page and the Ocean getting-started page fetched here do not state a unit price and do not contain a sampler assignment.
gaps.would_need: The Leap customer-plans page, with a price, and an Ocean page whose code selects a QPU solver.

gaps.topic: Quantinuum Nexus device selection and price
gaps.why: The systems page says Helios and System Model H2 computers are available to subscription users. The fetched page does not contain a device-name assignment, and it does not state a price. Azure's pricing page states a Standard Plan monthly price for System Model H2.
gaps.would_need: A Nexus page with the line that sets the hardware target, and a Quantinuum price for direct Nexus access.

gaps.topic: IQM Resonance device-selection line
gaps.why: The Resonance page lists Crystal 54, Crystal 20, and Star 24, a free credit allowance, and a per-second price. It does not contain a code line that selects a QPU.
gaps.would_need: IQM Resonance documentation with the call that names the QPU.

gaps.topic: Braket prices missing for two listed QPUs
gaps.why: The devices page lists IonQ Forte-Enterprise-1 and Rigetti Ankaa-3. The pricing table rows name Forte and Cepheus, and do not name Forte-Enterprise-1 or Ankaa-3.
gaps.would_need: A pricing row that names Forte-Enterprise-1 and a row that names Ankaa-3.

gaps.topic: Azure Quantinuum qubit counts differ across Microsoft pages
gaps.why: The provider page dated 2026-05-15 says 56 qubits for quantinuum.qpu.h2-1 and quantinuum.qpu.h2-2. The target list dated 2026-04-23 says 20 qubits for Quantinuum H2-1 and 32 qubits for Quantinuum H2-2.
gaps.would_need: A Microsoft page that states which count is current.

gaps.topic: IBM Open Plan time wording
gaps.why: The plans guide says up to 10 minutes per 28-day rolling window. The pricing page says up to 10 minutes of runtime per month.
gaps.would_need: One IBM page that states which window the Open Plan uses.
